# Frontend Rules

## UI Style

Inspiration:

- Revolut
- N26
- Monzo
- Stripe Dashboard

Characteristics:

- Clean
- Minimal
- Professional
- Financial software aesthetic

---

## Page Layout

Desktop:

Sidebar + Main Content

Mobile:

Bottom Navigation

Tabs:

- Dashboard
- Scan
- Analytics
- AI Assistant
- Settings

---

## Dashboard

Components:

- Monthly Spending Card
- Annual Spending Card
- Average Spending Card
- Recent Expenses
- Spending Trends

---

## Analytics

Visualizations:

- Line Charts
- Bar Charts
- Pie Charts
- Category Breakdown
- Spending Heatmap

Use Apache ECharts.

---

## Component Standards

- Standalone Components
- OnPush Change Detection
- Signals first approach
- Smart/Dumb component separation

---

## Accessibility

All pages must:

- be keyboard accessible
- provide ARIA labels
- maintain WCAG compliance
- support screen readers

---

## Responsive Design

Mobile:
320px+

Tablet:
768px+

Desktop:
1280px+
